Tuesday, March 23, 2021  5:00 PM  Teleconference

  JOINT MEETING WITH THE PLANNING COMMISSION
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Joint City Council meeting with the Planning
Commission to be called to order via teleconference at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, March 23, 2021. The agenda for
the Special Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, March 18, 2021.
  Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20 and current State and County Public Health Orders,
  City Council Members will be participating via teleconference.

  - City Council meetings are recorded and live-streamed on the City’s website at www.rhe.city and
  available for viewing thereafter, and televised on Cox 33 and Frontier FiOS 38 on Wednesday and Friday
  following the meeting.

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 827 7299 9410, Meeting Password: 066081. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call-in option from a phone line.)

  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at cityclerk@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. E-mails
  received before 3:00 p.m. the night of the Council meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.

  - Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 827 7299 9410, Meeting Password: 066081.

  - Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using
  the following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand"
  option at the lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which
  item on the agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL & PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MARCH 23, 2021

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special Joint Meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission of the City of Rolling
Hills Estates was called to order by MAYOR ZUCKERMAN at 5:03 p.m. via teleconference,
pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 and current State and County Public
Health Orders.

SALUTE TO THE FLAG

Flag salute led by MAYOR ZUCKERMAN.

2.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present: Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent: None

Planning Commissioners Present: Medawar, Schachter, Yoo, Carman, Scott, Edler

Planning Commissioners Absent: Zigrang

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Planning Manager Jeannie Naughton
  Community Development & PW Director David Wahba
  Interim City Clerk Carrie Gallagher

3.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE

4.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

A.  HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE COMMUNITY WORKSHOP (RECEIVED & FILED)
  INFORMATIONAL ITEM ONLY

Planning Manager Jeannie Naughton introduced the item and presented Housing Consultant
Veronica Tam of Veronica Tam & Associates who provided a report (as per the agenda
material).

Ms. Tam delivered an overview of the Housing Element requirements to meet the City’s
housing demand needs. She provided an explanation of the Regional Housing Needs
Allocation (RHNA) and how to plan for it. In addition, she discussed residential sites inventory
and consequences of non-compliance.

Project Manager/Urban Planner Surabhi Barbhaya with Michael Baker International (MBI)
discussed sites identified to accommodate affordable, low-income housing.

Discussion ensued amongst City Council, staff and consultants regarding locations identified
as institutional land.

MAYOR ZUCKERMAN inquired if ADUs count toward the City’s RHNA allocation. Ms. Tam
replied that they do count only based on trend noting housing laws encourage a variety of
housing types.

Planning Manager Naughton noted a slight increase in ADU applications since 2020 and
discussion ensued regarding the potential to satisfy the lower income housing categories.
Overnight curbside parking impacts and restrictions were mentioned.

SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL & PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  1
MARCH 23, 2021
 Concern was voiced over re-designating zoning in the mixed-use Commercial District.

Planning Manager Naughton noted that it’s not the responsibility of the City to build the
affordable units, rather it’s about removing the barriers so the units can be built.

Public Comment:

Ian Lundy long time resident of Rolling Hills Estates, encourages and supports growth in and
around the existing mixed use district rather then spread throughout Palos Verdes, he added
that the commercial district is a great option to add density where there is actual infrastructure
to support it with access to transportation and social amenities while not increasing
dependency on cars.

Alana Zang, through written comment voiced support for the previous speaker’s comments.

  MAYOR ZUCKERMAN SO ORDERED THE ITEM RECEIVED, HE NOTED THIS WAS
  AN INFORMATIONAL ITEM ONLY

B.  FOCUSED PLAN FOR THE COMMERCIAL DISTRICT (RECEIVED & FILED)

Community Development & Public Works Director David Wahba introduced the item. City
consultants Surabhi Barbhaya, John Bellas, Dan Wery, and Peter Quintanilla with MBI
provided a report (as per the agenda material).

Discussion ensued regarding revisiting the design concepts of the Commercial District to take
into account the realities of existing conditions and geotechnical constraints, the feasibility of
major changes such as roadway modifications, and the viability of selected housing sites.

  MAYOR ZUCKERMAN SO ORDERED THIS ITEM RECEIVED & FILED

5.  NEXT STEPS

Draft Housing Element will be reviewed by the Planning Commission in May and the City
Council in June.

The Draft EIR and General Plan will be released for public review in August 2021.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

At 7:52 P.M. MAYOR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the City Council meeting to the 7:00 pm
Regular City Council meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Carrie Gallagher, CMC  Steve Zuckerman
Interim City Clerk  Mayor

SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL & PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  2
MARCH 23, 2021
